ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-05-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: P. Dias, CSR: Sonia Wong.
Matter continued from December 13, 2005 for the appearance of Minor's mother.
Petitioner: Paul W. Aparicio, present, in pro per, as Guardian ad Litem for Minor: Mario
Antonio Judkins. Also present Mother: Dayna Judkins and with proper ID.
Parties sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Mario Antonio Aparicio.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-13-2005 Reset To Jan-05-06 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tina Paxton.
Petitioner: Paul W. Aparicio, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Mario Antonio Judkins, was sworn and examined.
Statement consenting to the name change by the Minor's Mother: Dayna Judkins, received in court, and signature is not matched to the signature on the birth certificate presented.
At Petitioner's request, matter is continued to Jan. 5, 2006 at 9:00 A.M. in Dept. 218, for an appearance of Dayna Judkins and with proper ID.
